layers.method: DEM: GEM-15 (experimental, model-predicted) DTM 15 m area-averaged to 30 m, gaps from Copernicus GLO-30. HAND = height above the main-stem D8 flow-path cell each cell drains to (pysheds, HydroRIVERS channel burned −2 m). Corridor ≤ 5 km from the path, dam→120 km cap (120 km), reservoirs and sea excluded. V(h) = Σ(h − HAND)·900 m² over HAND < h. Exposure: ESA WorldCover 2021 cropland (40) and built-up (50) area fractions at 30 m, WorldPop 2020 constrained (population), Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (2023-04-25 release, ODbL) centroids, OSM roads (all classes incl. tracks), villages = OSM place=city|town|village|hamlet whose built cells (building centroid or ≥ 25 % WorldCover built-up) within 300 m of the node lie below h. Corridor grid in flood/hand_grid.json (30 m); uint16 cm, 65535 = outside.
layers.uncertainty: Scenario exploration, not a forecast. 30 m terrain. Static 'bathtub': the whole volume is spread at one height along the entire corridor at once (no timing, attenuation or channel capacity), so it underestimates depth near the dam and overstates simultaneous extent downstream. HAND ≈ 0 inside depression-filled channel reaches (8 km² 'wet' at h = 0.25 m): volumes below ≈ 4.2 Mm³ (h < 0.5 m) are not meaningful. No channel bathymetry; GEM-15 is a model-predicted DTM and GLO-30 is a surface model (trees, buildings); OSM buildings and roads are incomplete (lower bounds); WorldPop is itself a model. ROADS PARTIAL: OSM roads were downloaded only for the corridor chunks [0, 1] (each ≈ 34.3 km of river from the dam); road_km counts only those.
layers.label: Height above the river (HAND)
